title: 第748章 机缘第747章 剑经
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 旁边，负责此次拍卖拍品事务的负责人看了一眼，连忙开口回应。
“这是下面的人送上来的一卷剑经，据说是一白衣剑修拿来，样子陌生，不似我沧澜城人。”
“白老，您给看看，这剑经可能上拍卖会？我观那子气息不弱。”
话虽如此，他心里却并不看好，只是随意走个过场罢了。
十二重楼的规定，不管是多么不被看好的拍品，都必须经由鉴定师鉴定，才能决定最后的归属。
一旦错漏，绝不姑息！
只可惜……
这毕竟是剑经。
负责人心中随意的想着。
很多人一辈子都不一定能够修出剑意，多数人卡在三四重的境界。
剑道，实在是太难了。
写一本可用的剑经，更是难上加难。
那年轻人气息虽然可以，但是，他才多大？
能修出来五六重的剑经，他便算对方是天才，还什么自己写的剑经……
大概也就是入门品阶，万以计数灵石的货色吧。
倒是也不能说完全没用。
这等剑修的剑道感悟，说高也不高，说低也不算是太低，勉强可以指导一部分剑修入门，但是再多的却是不行了。
想要卖个好价格，可以说是难如登天。
但十二重楼来者不拒。
顶多是够不上上拍卖会的标准罢了。
被称为白老的鉴定师看了一眼负责人拿来的龙纹剑经，只是看了一眼就气笑了。
他当即翻了个白眼。
“司小子，你这是在消遣我老人家呢吧！”
他随意翻了翻手中的那本剑经，露出来一个无奈又无语的表情。
“这是剑经！”
“你知道什么叫做剑经吗？老头子我这辈子，只会鉴定，你让我看看丹药宝器尚且没问题，但是你让老头子读剑经，怎么，你们十二重楼这是想要换人了又不好意思说，非打算让老头子我读一遍然后经血逆流而亡？”
白老的话没说完，负责人自己也意识到了不对的地方。
功法这东西，一般都好鉴定。
毕竟，传承于某某强者的功法，或者某某类型的功法，基本上都师出有名。
十二重楼已经很多年没有收到过修士自己写的功法了。
还是剑经。
content_en:
Next to him, the person in charge of the auction items took a look and quickly responded.
"This is a scroll of Sword Scripture sent by the people below. It is said that it was brought by a sword cultivator in white. He looks strange and does not look like me from Canglan City."
"Lao Bai, please take a look. This sword scripture may be auctioned? I think that guy's aura is not weak."
Even so, he was not optimistic about it and was just going through the motions.
According to the regulations of the Twelve-Storied Building, no matter how unfavorable the auction item is, it must be appraised by an appraiser before the final ownership can be determined.
Once a mistake is made, we will never tolerate it!
It's a pity...
This is the Sword Book after all.
The person in charge thought casually.
Many people may not be able to cultivate sword intent in their lifetime, and most people are stuck at the third or fourth level.
Kendo is really too difficult.
It is even more difficult to write a usable Sword Book.
Although he has a youthful aura, how old is he?
If he could cultivate five or six levels of Sword Scripture, he would consider the other party to be a genius, so why should he write the Sword Scripture himself...
It's probably the entry level, with tens of thousands of spiritual stones.
It can't be said that it is completely useless.
This level of swordsman's understanding of swordsmanship is neither high nor too low. It can barely guide some swordsmen to get started, but it won't be enough for many more.
It can be said that it is extremely difficult to sell it at a good price.
But no one will be turned away from the Twelfth Floor Tower.
At most, it's not up to the standards of auction.
The appraiser known as Bai Lao glanced at the Dragon Pattern Sword Sutra brought by the person in charge, and laughed angrily after just one glance.
He immediately rolled his eyes.
"Boss Si, are you just entertaining my old man?"
He casually flipped through the Sword Book in his hand, showing a helpless and speechless expression.
"This is the Sword Scripture!"
"Do you know what the Sword Scripture is? Old man, I have only done appraisals in my life. It's okay if you let me see the elixirs and treasures, but you ask the old man to read the Sword Scripture. Why, do you want to replace someone in the Twelfth Floor Building but are embarrassed to say it? You don't want to let me read it once and then die of menstrual blood flow?"
Before Bai Lao finished speaking, the person in charge realized something was wrong.
Kung Fu is generally easy to identify.
After all, the skills inherited from a certain strong person, or the skills of a certain type, are basically from famous masters.
It has been many years since the Twelfth Level Tower received any exercises written by the monks themselves.
Or the Sword Scripture.
